messages:
Ava: heads-up from UX review: the in-console docs side panel opens fine, but keyboard users lose their place when it closes. also the panel header says 'Reference' while the top nav uses 'Docs' and help tooltips say 'Support'. can we consolidate naming and fix focus restoration?

Liam: noted. focus loss is because we replace the route instead of using history.pushState. if we pushState and mount the side panel client-side we can keep the original activeElement and restore it on close. plan: save `previousActive = document.activeElement` then call `previousActive?.focus()` after unmount with requestAnimationFrame.

Noah: for naming I'd prefer 'Docs' everywhere. it's concise and matches SEO/docs.site. we should update UI labels: global nav tooltip, side panel title, and in-product headings. PR should include a small migration note for bookmarked links.

Sofia: accessibility checklist: - side panel must have role="dialog" + aria-labelledby pointing to the title - when opened, set `inert` or `aria-hidden="true"` on the main app region - ensure the close button is the first focusable control with aria-label="Close docs" - when deep-linking to a section, announce via aria-live: "Showing section: <Section Name>".

ContrastBot: audit result: callout badge at small size fails 3:1 contrast on dark theme. recommend switching to --accent-600 for bg and white text to meet 4.5:1.

Ava: also UX request: when user clicks a docs link that opens a new tab, show a small transient toast: "Opening docs in a new tab" with an action "Return to Console" that focuses the console window when clicked. keeps people oriented.

Liam: implementation note: external links should keep target=_blank rel="noopener" but add aria-label="Opens in new tab" and append a visually-hidden screen reader hint. also add an icon visually. For internal links we intercept clicks: if href startsWith(location.origin) or path includes /docs, call preventDefault, pushState({openDocs: section}), and render panel.

Noah: copy change proposal for side panel intro: "Docs: quick reference and examples for console features." short, consistent. Also update search index anchors to map `docs#kv-cache` -> `openDocs=kv-cache`.

Sofia: QA tasks: unit test for pushState handler, e2e keyboard flow asserting focus restore, axe accessibility scan, manual screen reader check for aria-live announcement.

Liam: branch `feature/docs-panel-pushstate-1805` with initial fixes: focus restore, aria-labelledby, external link aria, and updated tokens for badge. will add tests next.

Ava: product follow-ups: 1) run a micro-survey in #beta about changing 'Help/Support/Reference' to 'Docs' 2) confirm updated copy in docs.site to use 'Docs' as canonical term.

Noah: small edge-case: if user opens multiple docs panels or deep-links to different anchors, ensure we set focus to first tabbable element and update history.replaceState for subsequent anchors instead of pushing new entries every time.

ContrastBot: re-run recommended after CSS token change. Also check focus ring contrast on dark theme.

Liam: deploying to staging in ~10m. will attach staging URL and a short screencast showing keyboard open -> esc -> focus restore.

Ava: thanks. tagging @design for visual check and @eng-oncall for staging deploy window. :rocket:
